about: Third-party code that the MCP SDK packages carry inside their own dist files (their //#region .../node_modules/.pnpm/<pkg>@<ver> markers), so it has no node_modules folder whose license file build.mjs could read. Each license file under licenses/ is package/LICENSE copied byte for byte from the npm tarball whose integrity is recorded here (checked against the registry on 2026-11-28). build.mjs writes these into dist/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and stops when the bundle reaches a vendored package that is not listed, or a region from node_modules in a layout other than that pnpm one; test/third-party-notices.test.ts fails when this list and the packages the bundles reach differ.
